authorityPolicy: Status and confidence counts are reported, not release incentives. Factual accuracy, record freshness, valid profiles, and field completeness are gated separately.

ownershipRebaseline.reason: Fresh upstream snapshots no longer contain CODEOWNERS at root, .github, or docs for three prior ownership records; one other record gained ownership. Do not retain removed owners to satisfy an old count.

docsRebaseline.reason: The October source-declared documentation policy (documentation fields require a supporting declaration; URL shape alone no longer populates docs) plus the 2026-10-27 full-index catch-up refresh reduced hasDocs from 361 to an observed 172 and hasOwnershipSignal from 116 to an observed 114. Retaining inferred documentation URLs to satisfy the old count would misrepresent the current policy. Minimums are set just below observed values (165/110) so normal record churn does not flap the gate.

licenseRebaseline.reason: The identity migration to nvm-windows/nvm revealed a rewritten upstream without a root license; GitHub license API returns 404. Retaining the old MIT declaration would misrepresent the current revision.
